sqlMap.select: SELECT KEY_7 AS TOKEN FROM ICOMTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = 'TOKEN' AND TARGET = 'PARCEL'

SELECT parcel_com_code AS carrierId, parcel_no AS trackingNumber, 'https://eai.koreab2b.com:9191/parcel.do' AS callbackUrl, to_char(sysdate +2,'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS expirationTime FROM KEP.kep_parcel WHERE IF_FLAG = 'N' AND PARCEL_ID = 'B'
sqlMap.update: UPDATE KEP.KEP_PARCEL SET IF_FLAG = #flag#, IF_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE IF_FLAG = 'N' AND PARCEL_COM_CODE = #carrierId# AND PARCEL_NO = #trackingNumber# AND PARCEL_ID = 'B'
sqlMap.select: SELECT PARCEL_COM_CODE AS CARRIERID, PARCEL_NO AS TRACKINGNUMBER FROM KEP.KEP_PARCEL WHERE IF_FLAG IN ('N','Y','S') AND PARCEL_ID = 'B'
sqlMap.update: UPDATE KEP.KEP_PARCEL SET IF_FLAG = #flag#, IF_DATE = SYSDATE, START_DATE = DECODE(IF_FLAG||#flag#,'SS',IF_DATE,SYSDATE), PRO_STATUS = CASE #status# WHEN 'UNKNOWN' THEN '상태미확인' WHEN 'INFORMATION_RECEIVED' THEN '배송정보접수' WHEN 'AT_PICKUP' THEN '집하완료' WHEN 'IN_TRANSIT' THEN '배송중' WHEN 'OUT_FOR_DELIVERY' THEN '배송출발' WHEN 'ATTEMPT_FAIL' THEN '배송실패' WHEN 'DELIVERED' THEN '배송완료' WHEN 'AVAILABLE_FOR_PICKUP' THEN '수령가능' WHEN 'EXCEPTION' THEN '배송예외' ELSE '기타' END, PRO_STATUS_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') WHERE IF_FLAG IN ('N','Y','S') AND PARCEL_COM_CODE = #carrierId# AND PARCEL_NO = #trackingNumber# AND PARCEL_ID = 'B'
UPDATE KEP.KEP_PARCEL SET IF_FLAG = 'E', IF_DATE = SYSDATE, JOB_NOTE = NVL2(JOB_NOTE, JOB_NOTE || ' ', '' ) || #err# WHERE IF_FLAG IN ('N','Y','S') AND PARCEL_ID = 'B'
sqlMap.insert: INSERT INTO KEP.KEP_PARCEL_DT ( FID, INVOICE_NO, TIME_TRANS, TIME_SWEET, DETAILS, COMCODE ) VALUES ( #fid#, #trackingNumber#, #lastTime#, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), #details#, #carrierId# )
